title: Bugs Bunny and friends
description: A painting shows three cartoon rabbits standing in a row. On the left is a brown rabbit with a long snout and big smile, in the middle is a gray rabbit with hands on hips, and on the right is a gray rabbit wearing a red bow tie with one hand on his chin.
prompt: A finished painting shows three cartoon rabbits standing side by side on a painted floor against a dark abstract background. On the left an orange brown rabbit with long snout stands with hands on hips and wide smile. In the center a gray rabbit with white belly stands with hands on hips and smiling face. On the right a gray rabbit with white muzzle wears a red bow tie and red shoes and stands with one hand touching his chin. Red leaves and small flowers on the ground. Painted in vibrant colors with visible brush strokes.
